visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young male with short hair, wearing a black cap, glasses, and a black T-shirt, is sitting on a beige fabric sofa in a dimly lit living room with a warm lamp in the background. He speaks expressively to the camera with frequent hand gestures and eyebrow movements. (2) The man stands up abruptly, looking agitated. High-contrast graphic overlays of orange fire sparks and large white text '暴走' appear behind him to emphasize his intense energy. (3) Red traditional lanterns with the character '福' and red firecracker graphics appear on the sides of the screen. The man mimics the physical action of pushing something away with both hands while leaning forward. (4) The scene cuts rapidly between different standing poses as the man continues his monologue. White impact lines flash on the screen to accentuate his dramatic movements and facial expressions. (5) Graphic text overlays representing complex family relationships appear beside his head as he gestures towards the side, looking frustrated and confused. (6) Static images of traditional Lunar New Year dishes—shrimp, braised pork knuckles, and steamed fish—are superimposed on the frame as he points towards them. (7) He transitions to holding a green and red bag of 'Cadina' snacks. The background changes to show close-up product shots of the snack packaging against a festive red background with cherry blossoms. (8) He is shown eating the snack with an exaggerated, happy expression while cartoon graphics of potato sticks fall into his mouth. (9) He holds both flavors of the snack bags, smiling broadly at the camera. (10) A final outro screen appears with a cartoon character logo holding a microphone and social media search text.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-energy male vocal begins with a fast speech rate and high pitch variability. An upbeat electronic BGM with a strong kick drum starts simultaneously. (2) Vocal intensity spikes into shouting. A sharp 'whoosh' SFX and a heavy 'thud' impact effect occur as the speaker stands up. (3) The speaker shifts his vocal tone to a nasal, high-pitched caricature of an elderly woman. A percussive 'ding' SFX marks the appearance of visual text elements. (4) Rapid-fire narration continues with a tight rhythm. Multiple 'pop' and 'cartoon slide' SFX are layered under the vocal to synchronize with visual graphics. (5) The BGM swells slightly as the speaker introduces the snack brand. His tone becomes more persuasive and bright. (6) A final brand stinger SFX—a synthesized chime and a quick vocal tag—plays during the outro screen.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Problem Identification -> Escalation -> Solution -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video uses a high-energy comedic rant to highlight the social stresses and inconveniences of the Lunar New Year (giving/taking red envelopes, complex relative titles, excessive food). It then seamlessly pivots to position Cadina snacks as the stress-free solution for convenient festive snacking.
